\vspace{-10pt}

# Policies {-}

* No late days or extensions are allowed.

* Each homework assignment may be completed in groups of maximum 2 members per group.

* Each homework assignment contributes equally to the weight corresponding to homework (70%).

* You must submit a file in PDF format or a Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb). 

* Together with the PDF file you must attach^[If you use a Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) it is not necessary to send a script (.py).] a Python *script* (.py) and email it to engin604assignments@gmail.com. 

    The name of the PDF file or Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) must be \textcolor{red}{\faExclamationTriangle}: 

    * [last-name-student-1]-[last-name-student-2]-homework[number].pdf; for example, for the solution to homework 3 you should name your file **cabrera-denbraber-homework3.pdf** or **cabrera-denbraber-homework3.ipynb**
    
    The name of the script must be \textcolor{red}{\faExclamationTriangle}: 

    * [last-name-student-1]-[last-name-student-2]-homework[number].py;  for example, for the solution to homework 3 you should name your file **cabrera-denbraber-homework3.py** 
    
    The subject of the email must be \textcolor{red}{\faExclamationTriangle}: 
    
    * [last-name-student-1]-[last-name-student-2]-homework[number];  for example, for the solution to homework 3 you should name the email subject **cabrera-denbraber-homework3**
    
* Homework must be submitted before 11:59pm on the due date indicated in the assignment statement.

* Any external source (*papers*, books, lectures, etc) used must be referenced (it does not count toward the maximum number of pages indicated in the assignment statement).

* All of the above also applies to those who wish to complete the homework individually.
